messages:
deploybot: :warning: HOLD APPLIED — Release 'orbit-v3.4.0' scheduled 2026-02-14T22:00Z is on hold due to incident INC-2026-042 (redis replica failover eu-west-1). Tag: orbit-v3.4.0. Waiting for @jessica to ack.
jessica: ack. thanks. mike-oncall can you confirm incident scope? do we need rollback for the recent canary?
mike-oncall: ongoing failover. replica recovered but replication lag spiked. throttling seen for token-service (~260ms p90). mitigation in progress, ETA ~35-45m. recommend hold; do NOT roll forward canary.
anil: QA — freeze any release-side DB migrations. if we rollback, migrations must be reversible. which services included migrations in this release?
jessica: orbit-service + route-cache touched a cache-key rename (no schema). safe to revert to v3.3.9. rachel, please confirm pin decision.
rachel: confirm. pin to v3.3.9 for traffic until incident is cleared. propose reschedule full rollout to 2026-02-15T01:30Z (change window). ops + qa pls ack.
carol-qa: ack from QA. we'll run regression suite once pin is applied. do not trigger smoke runs until we confirm.
jessica: deploybot — how do we pin via API/console?
rachel: example pin command: ```bash
curl -X POST 'https://console.redwood/api/releases/pin' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"service":"orbit","version":"v3.3.9","reason":"incident rollback to stable"}'
```
deploybot: Pin requested by rachel. Action: PIN v3.3.9 -> orbit route. Result: PIN APPLIED. Canary jobs cancelled. Rollback jobs queued: 2. Note: release notes preserved at https://console.redwood/releases/orbit/3.4.0
mike-oncall: i'll continue monitoring. if replication lag <50ms and errors stable for 10m we can consider re-trying a limited canary in eu-west-2 (low-traffic).
jessica: change window updated in calendar: https://calendar.redwood/company/releases/2026-02-15T01:30Z. release notes updated with incident footnote.
rachel: thanks team. i'll own post-mortem and rollback notes. tagging @security for audit logs.
deploybot: update: INC-2026-042 status -> stabilizing. next update in ~35m.
